UNESCO Silk Roads Youth Research Grant 2022 is an initiative by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization for postgraduate researchers. The grant aims to mobilize young researchers for further study of the Silk Roads shared heritage. The selected 12 scholars will receive USD 10,000 per research project.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Be 35 years of age at the time of application
Note - The proposed research will be carried out by an individual researcher or may be part of the research of a group or collaborative project.
The selected 12 scholars will receive twelve grants of USD 10,000 per research project.
Eligible candidates can apply for the grant by following the steps mentioned below -
button and read the details carefully.

The selection will be based on the fulfilment of eligibility criteria.
The submitted research proposals will be evaluated by a scientific panel comprised of renowned international academics.
